kind: deterministic fixtures: real Git, source transport and controller journals; synthetic ACP and check observations

throughput.note: Two single-loop graphs to their review hold, in one process. Role and check observations are synthetic, so this is harness overhead only: Git transport, journals, capture and verification envelopes.

independentEdits.reading: A clean textual merge of two individually passing candidates fails the pinned check: integration needs its own fresh verification.

overlappingEdits.reading: Two edits to the same line cannot be combined silently; merge-tree reports the conflicted path without touching any working tree.

failureIsolation.reading: Branches in separate graphs fail independently; the failed branch reconciles its completed child without another run.

serialContract.kernel: Replay admits an event only for the single current cursor node, and each effect node has exactly one success edge. Fan-out needs several cursors; fan-in needs a node whose input names several candidates.
